title: Wide Blaster, the WideMess devkit's sample game
description: A small horizontal shooter that uses every WideMess feature (docs/projects/widemess-spec.md): 8 layers of 256 colours at 400 x 224 in parallax, up to 199 sprites from the 256-sprite table (a 64 x 64 256-colour boss among them), a song on 11 of voices 8-31 with 16-bit PCM and BRR samples plus effects, fast CPU and fast DMA, every actor pool and a 64 KB flight recorder in the 1 MB work RAM. Made with 'brokendev new widemess widemess-sample', then grown. The devkit guide: docs/projects/widemess-devkit.md.

toolchain: PVSnesLib 4.6.0 (816-tcc, 816-opt, wla-65816, wla-spc700, wlalink, snesbrr), the copy in the Super VRUN workspace (snes-stub/toolchain/pvsneslib): read, never changed

steps.name: build
steps.note: wmsbuild.ps1: the converters (wms.json's graphics and sound), 816-tcc, wla-65816, wla-spc700, wlalink on PVSnesLib's HiROM libraries, Workshop --wms-pack --map 2.

run.note: The d-pad flies, B or Y fires, Start restarts after the game is over.

scenarios.why: 8 layers drawing, more sprites on the picture than a SNES table holds (128), more of the new voices sounding at once than the S-DSP has (8), the far work RAM in use, fast mode on

compat.what: Wide Blaster on BrokenNes only: no other emulator runs WideMess. game_frame counts the main loop's frames, snes_vblank_count PVSnesLib's vblanks: in fast mode the loop finishes every frame (at SNES speed it takes 2 to 3).

checks.what: the main loop keeps 60 frames a second (game_frame changes on every frame of 600-900)
the ship is alive at frame 300 (lives 1-3)
BrokenDev hardware checks (docs/projects/brokendev-debugging-plan.md, D4): every verify scenario runs again with the checks on; a finding not accepted here fails verify. Each acceptance says why.

accepted.reason: known: the sample's start-up lags its first 11 frames (dmaClearVram, wmsUpload, wmsSpritesInit, the tables, wmsSoundStart); the lagFrames budget holds the rest at 0

known (found by D4): the devkit's start-up does not clear work RAM, so this variable starts at the zeros BrokenNes powers on with; a WideMess powers on as a SNES (widemess-spec.md section 1: random work RAM). The fix belongs in the devkit's start-up (clear work RAM), and a game made from the template inherits it

budgets.what: Over a limit fails verify, near it (90%) warns; the report compares with the previous build (out/<id>/budget-history.json). romBankFree is an estimate (padding runs of 64 or more equal $00 / $FF bytes).

lagFrames.what: no lag frame once started; 0 on 2026-10-24

memoryFree.what: work RAM never read: 130256 and 912555 (of the 896 KB) on 2026-10-24

knownIssues: PVSnesLib counts the loading frames (graphics and the sound RAM image, about 360 KB through DMA) as lag: lag_frame_counter is 9 at the first frame of play and stays there.
